analysis.session_summary: Australian employment shocked lower at -43.5K vs 25.5K forecast, driving AUD to -0.565% strength and weighing on risk sentiment; VIX rose 9.469%. NZD led at +0.277% despite no usable RBNZ quotes, while CAD also held gains with no domestic driver. USD got a small lift from FOMC minutes (+0.066% impulse) but Philly Fed was muted at -0.010%. The tape closed risk-off in EM FX, with USD/MXN +1.558% and USD/ZAR +1.214%.

themes.theme: FOMC minutes mildly support USD but no surprise score

NZD strength +0.277%; NZD/USD +5.6 pips; RBNZ Breman no-data.

currency_drivers.USD: FOMC minutes gave USD a 0.066% lift; Philly Fed miss drew a muted -0.010% reaction.
currency_drivers.EUR: Lagarde speech muted; EUR closed at its best on cross flows, not domestic news.
currency_drivers.JPY: No Japanese releases; JPY weakened despite Ueda comments carrying no reaction.
currency_drivers.GBP: No UK releases; GBP's attempted gain was rejected, closing near lows.
currency_drivers.AUD: Australian employment miss -43.5K vs 25.5K forecast drove AUD sharply lower.
currency_drivers.CAD: No CAD-specific releases; CAD gained 0.25% with no clear driver.
currency_drivers.CHF: No Swiss releases; CHF traded flat and held its range.
currency_drivers.NZD: No clear catalyst; RBNZ Breman comments had no quotes and NZD held its bid.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: The tape was five choppy legs with no single catalyst; FOMC minutes contributed -7.6 pips in the first down leg, but the pair still closed +1.7 pips.

polarity_reads.read: Normal polarity; AUD moved 0.373% lower on a negative surprise, indicating crowded long AUD positioning.
USD strengthened 0.066% with no forecast to score; market read the minutes as not dovish, though ambiguity remains.
Muted 0.017% basket move; no new EUR impulse, positioning neutral.
Muted -0.010% basket move despite weak 6.3 vs 20.6; USD buyers ignored soft data, a mildly firm signal.
No quotes/no-data; no impulse, so NZD strength was flow-driven rather than policy-driven.

scenarios.name: AUD-led risk-off persists
scenarios.thesis: The Australian labor shock and higher VIX keep pressure on AUD and EM FX while USD holds gains.

pair_paths.rationale: AUD/USD closed down -49.7 pips after the jobs miss; continuation targets that leg again.
EUR/USD trapped in its 54.2 pip range with no clear catalyst.
USD/JPY closed +57.4 pips; USD firm with JPY weak supports another push.
NZD/USD held +5.6 pips despite risk-off; NZD resilience continues.

scenarios.name: Consolidation after event shock
scenarios.thesis: Markets digest the AUD jobs shock and FOMC minutes, leaving majors range-bound.
scenarios.invalidation: Break of range on high-impact data

pair_paths.rationale: EUR/USD chopped within 54.2 pips with no clear driver.
USD/JPY daily range 72.8 pips; pair may stay inside after 57.4 pip rally.
AUD/USD range 65.6 pips after its -49.7 pip drop; profit-taking may flatten.
GBP/USD range 74.6 pips with close near lows; consolidation likely.

scenarios.name: Risk-on reversal / AUD short squeeze
scenarios.thesis: Oversold AUD and stretched risk-off unwind; USD fades and high-beta bounces.

pair_paths.rationale: Largest AUD/USD up leg was 54.7 pips; a squeeze can retrace that leg.
EUR/USD second leg up was 50.9 pips; risk-on would favor another such move.
USD/JPY final down leg was -12.7 pips; if USD fades, expect similar pullback.

risks.why_it_matters: AUD strength already -0.565% and AUD/USD -49.7 pips; further downside could hit commodity FX.
USD own impulse +0.066% with DXY +0.111% could extend USD bids.
VIX +9.469% and USD/MXN +1.558% show stress; contagion can hit high-beta majors.
